overview_description.description: Kerning Cultures is a narrative podcast company focused on storytelling from the Middle East and its global diaspora. It produces investigative, documentary-style audio series that explore culture, identity, history, and social issues through human-centered narratives, aiming to amplify underrepresented voices and perspectives from the region.
